title: Protocol
description: A research protocol: an ordered list of steps. The app renders the step bar and drives the step agents directly from this file.

role.description: The instructions given to the agent for this step. Becomes the per-request `instructions`, prepended to the shared project record.

output.description: Field names this step writes into the project record.

reads.description: Ids of upstream steps whose entries this step reads.

tools.description: Tool names this step may call. Must match a tool registered in the tool registry.
